alt: A short film with no voice, like a photo shoot at a table. A pink dining room with a small table and a plate with a bite on it. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes strikes pose after pose next to the plate while the screen flashes white like a camera; a phone stands on the right, its screen lit. A cobalt figure walks over hungry, eyes on the plate, and gets a wide-eyed look from the first one, so it waits. More flashes, more poses. A label in the corner says TAKE 47. At the end both pulse, the first one pleased, the second one with narrowed eyes. The text stays: if someone sent you this, congrats: you're brunch staff. Photographer. Unpaid. The eggs are cold.

Seis flashes de 0,1 s (máx. 1 por segundo) con cortes de cámara a la que posa; la de cobalto (la 'staff') espera con hambre y termina con ojos de rendija: la pantalla y la escena dicen lo mismo. Mesa = compartir. [mejora] el plato con el bocado amarillo se lee como comida, no necesariamente huevos; el texto lo nombra. Sin manos, ojos blancos, sin reborde.
